items.title: 68090_Ed Garland oral history interview
items.q: Frankie [Enger] playing piano. Cantrell playing drums.

ctx.x: And I played out there with him. And he had Manuel Perez played trumpet. Eddie Atkins playing trombone. Lorenzo To playing clarinet.

items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1971-04-20
items.q: Frankie Haine on piano. Louis Cantrell on drums.

ctx.x: Frankie Haine on piano. Louis Cantrell on drums. Well, you see his son on the boat on Wednesday night. You know that, huh? I won't see him on the boat. You're not going on that boat? No. You don't like the boat? No. Ain't got no money on that boat.
You know that, huh? I won't see him on the boat. You're not going on that boat? No.
